item: Review folds for the RC2 head: macOS stderr lines held to the session byte budget, launcher exit fields validated at entry, pid reuse closed by start time, native_in_flight counted with its key, no-trace reason follows 128+N and Windows statuses
summary: One read of the head found seven things, each now pinned by a test that is red without its fix: 20 longest macOS template lines measured +284 B per session (shown lines now share 120 characters, a line that does not fit is counted in lines_cut, never cut); the launcher exit row copied status/signal/stamps unscrubbed and read the whole file (fields checked at entry, tail read); a Windows or macOS row is matched by pid alone so an older process with the same pid could be reported as this session's end (a row dated before the session start is skipped, the stderr read allowing 120 s for an abort before the stamp); native_in_flight was budgeted without its key (181 B, the core-dump stack drops from 589 to 570 so the 2,415 B total holds); the no-trace reason ignored 128+N and Windows fault statuses; the PowerShell wrapper compared headers case-insensitively; an unreadable previous native file was reported as absent. Not added: a pid_only_match flag on the exit record (bytes).
